activeTask.title: Durable generated-artwork retention across redeploy/restart
activeTask.designBoundary: Generated and manually uploaded artwork must remain retrievable after application process restart and deployment replacement. Durable retention must not depend on ephemeral application filesystem state, must preserve private access semantics, and must remain provider-replaceable.
requiredEvidence: trace every artwork write/read/delete path and identify whether any production path depends on local process filesystem state
prove current behavior with a focused restart/redeploy-style regression before changing implementation
select the existing durable storage authority if one already exists; otherwise introduce the smallest durable private storage boundary compatible with current runtime
preserve private artifact locator semantics and prevent public raw-answer or artwork leakage
prove generated and manual-uploaded artwork survive storage-gateway recreation and application-service recreation
prove missing/corrupt durable objects fail closed without silently accepting metadata-only records
exact-head unit/typecheck/lint/production build; Browser QA only if customer/owner UI changes
destructive deployed restart/redeploy recovery proof remains live evidence before DONE
